statement: A bulk-load command imports a declared table from a versioned input stream through bounded batches with durable checkpoint identity, source offset, schema digest, row counts, checksums, idempotent replay, and restart recovery; it routes writes through canonical SQL/transaction owners, reports rejected rows explicitly, and can prove source-to-target completeness without trusting its own success counter. Verified at HEAD 761dc17c7: no bulk-load or import command exists; docs/migration.md states there is no supported PostgreSQL-to-Lagrange migration or CDC surface, and 'bulk' in src/ is only the internal raft snapshot channel.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn an independent verifier before audit and handoff and record its stable evidence id.
Writes route through the canonical SQL/transaction owners; the loader owns checkpoint identity and replay. No bypass write path, no second transaction coordinator.
Start with one narrow source format (newline-delimited canonical JSON or CSV with an explicit schema); do not combine PostgreSQL CDC into this Quest.
Completeness is proven against an independent source checksum and key-range sample, not the loader's own success counter; rejected rows are reported explicitly with reasons.

Kill and restart the loader and one cluster node during import; resume must produce no duplicates and no gaps. Removing checkpoint identity or idempotent replay must fail reconciliation deterministically.
